output.review_comment:
Fixes 1 and 2 look fine. Periods now round up, so any period that has started is charged. Adding 5000 before dividing makes the rounding half-up.

Fix 3 (`cap = max(balance_cents // 5, MINIMUM_FEE_CENTS)`) is a problem. The agent says it added this only to make test_small_balance_pays_minimum pass, and it contradicts the docstring. The docstring says the one-fifth cap always wins, which gives 360 for late_fee_cents(1800, 45). The test expects 500. The new line reverses which rule wins, so a small balance can now be charged more than a fifth of what's owed ($5 on $18 is 28%). That's a customer-facing policy change, and the code and docs now disagree about it.

Before merging:
(1) Ask finance whether the $5 minimum should override the one-fifth cap.
(2) If yes, update the docstring in this PR to say so, and replace the comment with one that explains the rule.
(3) If no, the test is wrong. Fixing it needs the teammate's sign-off, since they asked for the tests not to be changed.

Also please add a test for the period boundaries (30, 31, 60 and 61 days late), because rounding periods up changes what customers pay.
